requirement.description: The JobDefinition class accepts invalid Tags argument that should raise TypeError. Currently it allows passing a dict to Tags instead of rejecting it with TypeError.
requirement.contract: The JobDefinition class should validate that Tags parameter is not a plain dict and raises TypeError when it is. Only AWSHelperFn objects or Tags instances should be accepted for Tags parameter.
